snippet.title: Loot Survivor (Brute Intro) - The Hottest New Dungeon Crawler RPG
snippet.description:
There are many reasons to enter the Loot Survivor Dungeon. Some seek riches, some seek thrill, some do it out of pure:

G R E E D

Loot Survivor is a truly random, procedurally generated RPG dungeon crawler. Defeat beasts, upgrade your Adventurer, and collect loot as you endlessly fight for your life.

Live and FREE TO TRY!

Play: https://lootsurvivor.io/
Docs: https://docs.provable.games/lootsurvivor
Socials: https://x.com/LootSurvivor
Discord:  https://discord.gg/lootsurvivor
